theme_strategy.rationale: High contrast needed for sports environment (gyms, outdoors). Dark theme is default for elite/performance feel. Light theme uses an emerald tint.

headings.usage: Used for all scores, team names, and major headings. Creates a heavy-weight, athletic feel.

body.usage: Used for data tables, secondary text, and UI labels. High legibility.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use The Technical Look: 1px subtle borders, zero soft shadows. Brutalist structure to ensure readability at arm's length.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky bottom navigation, use backdrop-blur-xl with high opacity (bg-background/90) and a subtle top border. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.contrast: Scores must meet absolute maximum contrast. Use bright neon green or pure white on deep black for live scores.

grids.mobile_bento: High density grid. strict grid hierarchy, compact spacing. grid-cols-1 for mobile, md:grid-cols-2. Use gap-4.

public_view.navigation: Sticky Bottom Tab Bar (Games, Teams, Standings). Keeps reach zone optimized.
public_view.content: Dense lists for fixtures. High Density Grid for standing tables.

referee_view.one_handed_controller: The bottom 60% of the screen must be dedicated to scoring. Split vertically into two massive touch targets (Team A / Team B). No complex gestures. Thumb-zone optimized.
referee_view.safe_zone: Place 'Undo', 'Pause', and 'Complete' at the top 20% of the screen (out of the thumb zone) to prevent accidental taps during rapid scoring.

motion.interactions: Fast snaps. Use simple CSS active states for scaling down buttons (active:scale-95) to give tactile feedback when a referee taps +1.
motion.transitions: Instant or very quick (150ms). Sports apps need to feel real-time, not sluggish.

component_name.Card: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. No shadow. Used for fixtures.
component_name.Tabs: For switching Games/Teams/Standings. Customize to fill width evenly.
component_name.Button: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular for athletic feel.
component_name.Dialog: For referee PIN entry or confirming match completion.
component_name.Sheet: Bottom sheets for match details (replaces full-screen routing).
component_name.Progress: For visualizing team points to the target score (15).
component_name.Select: For admin assigning players to matches.
component_name.Input: For referee PIN or team naming.

route_map./: Public Dashboard. Header with 'Kurukshetra Picklewave'. Bottom Tabs: Games (default), Teams, Standings.
route_map./fixture/:id: Detailed view of 4 rounds x 3 matches. Running totals.
route_map./ref: Hidden route. Shows full-screen 4-digit PIN pad. On success, redirects to /referee.
route_map./referee: Referee Dashboard. List of assigned/active fixtures. 'Start Round' buttons.
route_map./referee/admin: Admin controls to create fixtures, select players, set teams.
route_map./referee/match/:id: LIVE SCORING UI. Top: Current Score. Bottom 60%: Giant +1 tap targets. Top right: Undo. Target score auto-completes at 15.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements. Scoring buttons must be at least 150x150px.

media.strategy: Functional relevance. Only use provided image URLs. Do not use placeholder services.

hero_background.description: Person holding a pickleball paddle. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for the header/hero section with bg-black/80 overlay.

3d_libraries: None required. Stick to high-performance 2D DOM elements to ensure real-time socket performance.

data_testing.instructions: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='team-a-score-btn', data-testid='ref-pin-input'.

steps: Initialize React + Tailwind CSS with mobile-first approach
Add Barlow Condensed and DM Sans fonts
Implement core layout wrapper with Theme toggle and Sticky Bottom Nav for public routes
Build the public views: Games List, Teams (with Captain (C)), Standings Leaderboard
Build the Referee Authentication (/ref) and Dashboard (/referee, /referee/admin)
Integrate WebSocket stubs/mock for real-time state synchronization
instructions_to_main_agent: Write code in .js files, NOT .tsx files.
Strictly follow the color palette. No purple/violet gradients.
Implement WebSockets mock/structure so that public state updates when referee clicks score.
Captain marker (C) must be placed next to player names in Teams list.
Leaderboard strictly sorted by total tournament points.
Scoring UI MUST be one-handed optimized (massive buttons, bottom placement).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
